The recursion W1=0,W2=01,W_{j+1}=W_j complement(W_{j-1}) follows from unique Zeckendorf leading-weight decomposition and has |W13|=377. Independently enumerated every 21-factor of W13 (132 distinct); W14 has same factors, set complement-invariant, and checked all 20 crossing factors for each of four periodic length20 suffix states S13..S16. The suffix relation S_{j+2}=complement S_j and stable prefix make this a genuine induction covering every future factor, rather than finite-prefix extrapolation. Every such factor has a zero in one of positions 20−a with a∈{0,4,6,7,9,10} and all those a have even weight; hence for every n>=20 some n−a has even weight. Direct finite small checks prove all n=6..19 representable and n<6 exceptions precisely 1,2,3,5. n=34 has no even-parity complement for a<10 among available small-even a=0,4,6,7,9, but 34=10+24 works; thus the uniform maximum 10 is sharp. Independent checker reconstructs the 132 factors, four joins, and all n<3000; the unbounded result is proved by induction.
